caption: Distribution of the winner signal — INDPRO 1-Month Momentum (column indpro_mom) — split into in-sample vs out-of-sample, with the winner threshold marked. Supersedes the prior chart that histogrammed INDPRO acceleration (wrong column).
narrative_alignment_note: Plain-English: this shows how often the industrial-production momentum signal took different values, comparing the period we tuned the strategy on (in-sample) with the period we tested it on (out-of-sample). The dashed line is the cutoff above which the strategy buys. It helps confirm the test period was not wildly different from the tuning period.
vera_rationale: Winner-signal IS/OOS distribution diagnostic; fixed from the displaced indpro_accel column to the actual winner column indpro_mom.
